## Joyflow PR record

The PR body must contain exactly one current-object record. The Web Brain writes only the Brain block; Codex writes only the Codex block. The mechanical workflow reads the exact current repository, approved Projection, Codex Return, Evidence Bundle, and Brain Review Capsule.

<!-- JOYFLOW_PR_RECORD_BEGIN
{
  "artifact_type": "JOYFLOW_PR_RECORD",
  "record_version": 4,
  "record_phase": "EXECUTION_ACTIVE",
  "repository_id": "owner/repo",
  "pr_number": 1,
  "base_sha": "CURRENT_BASE_SHA",
  "head_sha": "CURRENT_HEAD_SHA",
  "brain_block": {},
  "codex_block": {},
  "record_digest": "RECOMPUTE"
}
JOYFLOW_PR_RECORD_END -->
